title: prozor: Minimal Protein Set Explaining Peptide Spectrum Matches
description: R package. Determine the minimal set of proteins that explains the peptide spectrum matches (PSMs) of a mass spectrometry experiment, using a greedy parsimony algorithm. Annotate peptides with the proteins they match in FASTA sequence databases, and create FASTA databases with reversed decoy sequences and contaminant proteins. Compute and plot the coverage of protein sequences by the matched peptides. Estimate the false discovery rate (FDR) of target-decoy search results at the PSM, precursor, peptide and protein level, following Elias and Gygi (2007) and Käll et al. (2008). Compute variable precursor isolation windows for data-independent acquisition (DIA) from the distribution of precursor (MS1) masses.
